shadows.name: state-node-low
shadows.purpose: Separates state nodes from chart edges.

components.name: Active Mode Control
components.css: .ds-mode { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2b5278; color: #edf4fa; padding: 6px 13px; font: 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-mode:hover { background: #334f69; } .ds-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc1ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Starter Select
components.css: .ds-select { border: 1px solid #4b647b; border-radius: 8px; background: #223242; color: #edf4fa; padding: 7px 34px 7px 10px; font: 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: #6bc1ff; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc1ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workbench Pane
components.description: Contains source, chart, or preview content.
components.css: .ds-pane { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #334658; border-radius: 14px; background: #1e2b38; color: #edf4fa; } .ds-pane h2 { margin: 0; padding: 9px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid #334658; font: 750 12px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-pane p { margin: 0; padding: 16px; color: #9bb0c3; } .ds-pane:focus-within { border-color: #4b647b; }

components.name: Selected State Node
components.description: Shows one selected state and its preview.
components.css: .ds-state { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 260px; border: 1px solid #f3c76d; border-radius: 12px; background: #131d27; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(4, 10, 15, 0.24), 0 0 0 2px rgba(243, 199, 109, 0.28); color: #edf4fa; padding: 10px; text-align: left; } .ds-state strong { color: #6bc1ff; font: 700 11px/1.3 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-state:hover { border-color: #6bc1ff; } .ds-state:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc1ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Telegram Message
components.css: .ds-message { width: fit-content; max-width: 320px; min-width: 110px; border-radius: 12px; background: #182533; color: #edf4fa; padding: 8px 10px; font: 12px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Telegram Inline Action
components.description: Shows a read-only Telegram inline action.
components.css: .ds-action { display: block; border-radius: 8px; background: #29435c; color: #dff2ff; padding: 6px; font: 11px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: Sample Data Badge
components.description: Marks a preview that uses sidecar sample data.

narrative.overview:
The playground is a compact technical workbench. It combines Telegram message forms with a clear statechart canvas. Dark layered surfaces keep attention on state changes, views, and source data.

The interface uses dense controls and direct labels. Blue marks actions and structure. Warm yellow marks the selected state and sample data.
keyCharacteristics: Read-only source, chart, and preview panes
Preview-first order on narrow inspector screens

rules.name: The One Warm Signal Rule
rules.body: Use sample gold only for selection and sample-data status.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Keep state names and transition labels in monospace type.

rules.name: The Flat Pane Rule
rules.body: Keep main panes flat. Use shadow only on chart nodes and interactive focus states.

dos: Do keep source, chart, and preview roles visually distinct.
Do use blue for navigation, focus, and chart structure.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px high where space permits.
Do keep mobile DOM order equal to visible order.
donts: Don't add decorative color without a semantic role.
Don't use proportional type for state identifiers or JSON.
Don't make preview buttons behave like live Telegram actions.
Don't use large shadows on workbench panes.
